Fleur de Perle. Watercolor Floral and Pearl Collection

Fleur de Perle is a watercolor collection featuring ranunculus flowers, hydrangeas, lace motifs and pearl accents. All elements were hand painted and carefully digitized to maintain the original watercolor texture and realistic botanical appearance.

The collection combines blush pink florals, powder blue hydrangeas, muted eucalyptus greenery and luminous pearl accents, creating a timeless palette suitable for wedding and feminine design projects.

Inside the collection you will find more than 140 hand painted elements including

floral wreaths

floral frames

seamless patterns

seamless borders

compositions

isolated elements

bonus – lace elements!

Perfect for wedding invitations, bridal branding, stationery, packaging, fabric prints, surface pattern design, greeting cards, social media graphics, wall art, logos, event materials and printable products.

All elements are provided in high resolution 300 DPI PNG format with transparent backgrounds, making them easy to mix, match and customize for both personal and commercial projects.
